_comment: Candidate models. deployment_status here is the static default; for a model with a 'weights' block Lumon replaces it at runtime with STAGED (weights file present at the expected size, checksum verified when loaded) or NOT STAGED. Check each model's licence before staging.

models.name: Prithvi-EO-2.0 (family)
models.task: Earth-observation foundation encoder: embeddings, fine-tuning for land cover and change
models.source: IBM / NASA geospatial foundation models (Hugging Face: ibm-nasa-geospatial)
models.expected_input: Multispectral satellite time series (HLS-like bands), image chips
models.expected_output: Embeddings; with task heads: class maps or change maps
models.compute_notes: Transformer encoder; a GPU is recommended. CPU inference on the Apple M4 development machine is untested.

models.name: SAM 2 (Segment Anything Model 2)
models.expected_input: RGB imagery (best at sub-metre resolution) plus point/box prompts
models.compute_notes: Several model sizes exist; small variants may run on CPU slowly. Untested here.

models.name: ChangeFormer
models.compute_notes: Trained on public change benchmarks; needs retraining or validation for Indian campus imagery. GPU recommended. Untested here. Not used: its public checkpoints (LEVIR, DSIFN) are 0.5 m Google Earth RGB, a 20x resolution gap to Sentinel-2; BTC-B (OSCD) was chosen instead.

models.name: RemoteCLIP ViT-B-32 (image/text embedding)
models.task: Joint image-text embedding for semantic search on remote-sensing imagery
models.source: Liu et al., RemoteCLIP (IEEE TGRS 2024); github.com/ChenDelong1999/RemoteCLIP; weights huggingface.co/chendelong/RemoteCLIP
models.expected_input: RGB image chips (224 x 224 after resizing) and English text queries
models.expected_output: 512-dimensional image and text embeddings in one space; cosine similarity ranks chips for a text
models.compute_notes: CPU only on the Apple M4 development machine: weights load in about 1.2 s; about 9 ms per chip and 25 ms per text query; peak memory about 1.5 GB. Trained mostly on aerial/satellite imagery at sub-metre to a few metres resolution, so 10 m Sentinel-2 chips are outside its main training range.

models.name: BTC-B (Swin-B + UperNet), OSCD checkpoint — learned change detection
models.task: Bi-temporal change segmentation: before/after RGB pair -> per-pixel change score
models.source: Rolih et al., 'Be the Change You Want to See', IEEE TGRS 2025 (doi:10.1109/TGRS.2025.3585342); code github.com/blaz-r/BTC-change-detection @ db41090 (MIT); checkpoint huggingface.co/blaz-r/BTC-B_oscd96 @ 8666e51
models.license: Code MIT; checkpoint has no stated licence and was trained on OSCD (CC BY-NC-SA): treat as non-commercial research use only
models.expected_input: Two co-registered 8-bit true-colour (RGB) Sentinel-2 tiles of 96 x 96 px at 10 m, each resized to 256 x 256 and ImageNet-normalised; order = before, after
models.expected_output: One logit per pixel (256 x 256); sigmoid > 0.5 = change (BTC's own evaluation threshold)
models.training_data: OSCD: 24 Sentinel-2 L1C (top-of-atmosphere) image pairs, 2015-2018, worldwide cities; labels are URBAN changes only (new buildings, roads). Lumon's archive is L2A (surface reflectance): blue is darker than in OSCD's tiles.
models.verified_here: Reproduced on the OSCD test split (385 tiles, lossless PNG): F1 0.540, precision 0.620, recall 0.479, IoU 0.370 vs published 0.537-0.549 / 0.622-0.657 / 0.469-0.472 / 0.367-0.379.
models.compute_notes: CPU on the Apple M4: ~0.31 s per 256 x 256 tile pair; ~3.2 GB peak memory while loading; a 456 x 486 px scene pair (56 overlapping tiles) takes ~20 s.

weights.architecture: Swin-B (embed 128, depths 2-2-18-2, window 12) + UperNet (512), feature subtraction
weights.framework: transformers 5.18.0 (SwinBackbone) + torch 2.14.1 (CPU); legacy weight names mapped with transformers' own Swin renaming rules
